articles.title: Roadworks on Toad Lane and Surrounding Streets Scheduled for 6 November 2026
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Borough Council has announced that Toad Lane and nearby streets will be closed for roadworks on 6 November 2026, affecting Waterhouse Street, Redcross Street, and Lower Falinge.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Borough Council has confirmed that roadworks will take place on Toad Lane and surrounding streets on Sunday, 6 November 2026. The works will result in the temporary closure of Waterhouse Street, Redcross Street, and Lower Falinge from midnight until 11.59pm.

Access to Toad Lane will be restricted during the roadworks, and diversions will be in place. Residents and motorists are advised to plan their journeys accordingly to avoid disruptions.

For further information, residents can view a map of roadworks across Greater Manchester on the council's website.

articles.title: Tram Services Disrupted Due to Failed Tram at Trafford Bar
articles.excerpt: A failed tram at Trafford Bar has caused significant disruption to services affecting Rochdale and surrounding areas. Ticket acceptance is in place on several bus routes as a temporary measure.
articles.content_html:
A failed tram at Trafford Bar has disrupted tram services across several lines, including those connecting Rochdale Town Centre. The incident occurred on Friday, 21 August 2026, at approximately 3:54pm and is expected to continue until further notice.

As a result of the disruption, there are currently no tram services operating between Cornbrook and Trafford Bar. Services from Altrincham to Bury, Manchester Airport to Victoria, and East Didsbury to Rochdale Town Centre are among those affected.

In response to the disruption, ticket acceptance has been arranged on various bus routes, including the 23, 25, 41, 43, 85a, 101, 103, 248, 249, and 368. Passengers are advised to check for updates and plan their journeys accordingly.

Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has apologised for the inconvenience and is working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

articles.title: Rochdale AFC Signs Kane Taylor on Loan from Birmingham City
articles.excerpt: Rochdale have secured the loan signing of Kane Taylor from Aston Villa, with the 21-year-old midfielder joining the club until January 2027.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Football Club has announced the signing of midfielder Kane Taylor from Aston Villa on loan until January 2027. The 21-year-old player joins Rochdale after a loan spell at Oldham Athletic last season, where he made 16 appearances and scored two goals, helping the team finish 10th in League Two.

Despite not yet making his senior debut for Aston Villa, Taylor has shown promise, scoring for the Villa Under-21s in an EFL Trophy match against Wigan earlier this week. His experience in League Two is expected to bolster Rochdale's midfield options as they aim for a successful season.

Rochdale manager Ian Watson expressed his delight at securing Taylor's services, stating, "He brings a lot of athleticism and quality to the team, alongside experience in League Two." Watson's comments highlight the club's focus on enhancing their squad ahead of the upcoming fixtures.

The addition of Taylor is likely to provide a boost to Rochdale's performance as they prepare for their next match. Fans will be eager to see how the young midfielder integrates into the team and contributes to their campaign.

articles.title: Middleton Shopping Centre Receives Approval for New Signage and Improvements
articles.excerpt: Middleton Shopping Centre has received approval from Rochdale Council for new signage, marking a significant step in its ongoing redevelopment following its acquisition by AG Retail.
articles.content_html:
Middleton Shopping Centre has been granted permission by Rochdale Council to proceed with the next phase of its redevelopment. This phase involves the installation of new signage on the side of the centre facing the bus station, aimed at enhancing the overall appearance of the site.

The shopping centre, which was sold to AG Retail, a subsidiary of the Adhan Group, in June 2025, features 324,078 square feet of retail space across 87 units, along with a 430-space multi-storey car park. Notably, retailer Boyes is currently fitting out the former Wilko unit, while Mother Hubbard is preparing to open in a corner unit near the bus station.

According to the planning documents submitted to the council, the proposal includes the creation of two signage zones on the existing bus station car park elevation. These zones will consist of powder-coated aluminium panels finished in grey, designed to match the current elevation and provide a cohesive look for future tenant signage.

This application is part of a broader programme of investment and enhancement works at Middleton Shopping Centre. Earlier, on July 4, 2025, planning permission was granted for the addition of eight short-stay parking bays and two disabled parking bays to the south of the shopping centre. The latest developments are expected to improve the shopping experience for visitors and attract new tenants.

articles.title: Rochdale AFC Launches New Series 'Behind The Sign'
articles.excerpt: Rochdale AFC has introduced a new series titled 'Behind The Sign', offering fans an inside look at the club's preparations for the upcoming season.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale AFC has launched a new series called 'Behind The Sign', providing fans with exclusive insight into the club's preparations for the upcoming season. The pilot episode was published on August 21, 2026, and is available on the club's official website.

The series will feature training sessions, player interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, allowing supporters to engage more deeply with the team.

Fans are encouraged to watch the episodes as they are released to keep up with the club's activities and developments throughout the season.

For more information and to view the pilot episode, visit the Rochdale AFC website at https://rochdaleafc.co.uk/behind-the-sign-crawley-prep/.
